{"file_path":"/work/tests/test_loader.py","content":"import pytest

from safety_evals.loader import daily_flag_counts, dedupe_transcripts, parse_transcript_log


def test_parse_flags_and_field_whitespace():
    assert parse_transcript_log([" a , 1 , 1 \n", " b , -2 , 0 ", " c , 3 , \t"]) == [
        {"id": "a", "day": 1, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": -2, "flagged": False},
        {"id": "c", "day": 3, "flagged": None},
    ]


def test_parse_skips_blank_whitespace_and_comment_lines():
    lines = ["", " \t\n", "#comment", " \t# not,a,valid,record", "x,2,0"]
    assert parse_transcript_log(iter(lines)) == [{"id": "x", "day": 2, "flagged": False}]
    assert parse_transcript_log([]) == []
    assert parse_transcript_log(lines[:-1]) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_line", ["x,1", "x,1,0,extra", "x,no,1", "x,1.5,0", "x,,1"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("prefix", [[], ["", "  # comment", "ok,1,1", " \t"]])
def test_parse_errors_include_original_line_number(bad_line, prefix):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=rf"\bline {len(prefix) + 1}\b"):
        parse_transcript_log(prefix + [bad_line])


def test_dedupe_duplicate_ids_keeps_last_record_and_sorts():
    events = [
        {"id": "a", "day": 0, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": 2, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "c", "day": 1, "flagged": False},
        {"id": "a", "day": 5, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "a", "day": 2, "flagged": None},
    ]
    assert dedupe_transcripts(events) == [events[2], events[4], events[1]]
    assert dedupe_transcripts([]) == []


def test_daily_flag_counts_inclusive_range_with_zero_filling():
    events = [
        {"day": 0, "flagged": True},
        {"day": 1, "flagged": True},
        {"day": 1, "flagged": True},
        {"day": 2, "flagged": False},
        {"day": 3, "flagged": None},
        {"day": 5, "flagged": True},
        {"day": 6, "flagged": True},
    ]
    assert daily_flag_counts(events, 1, 5) == [2, 0, 0, 0, 1]
    assert daily_flag_counts(events, 1, 1) == [2]
    assert daily_flag_counts(events, 5, 1) == []


def test_daily_flag_counts_empty_and_negative_days():
    assert daily_flag_counts([], -2, 1) == [0, 0, 0, 0]
    assert daily_flag_counts([{"day": -1, "flagged": True}], -2, 0) == [0, 1, 0]
    assert daily_flag_counts([], 2, 1) == []
"}
